turns.text: Hi there! I’m here to help with this store’s orders, deliveries, payments, returns, products, and policies. I can’t answer general questions outside those topics, but I’d be glad to help with a store-related question.
My order ORD-1002 says my payment has failed yet my bank account was charged how is that possible?

I’m sorry—that’s worrying, and I can see why it seems contradictory. Our records show order ORD-1002 as shipped, while the payment record shows the attempt failed. Those records don’t tell me why fulfillment proceeded or whether your bank’s charge is pending or settled, so I don’t want to guess. I’ve created a support ticket for the team to review the order and payment records. It will only be sent to support when you submit a message using the ticket form.

I’ve created support ticket SUP-5C8712064AC7. To reach a support agent, send your details using the support form below; creating the ticket alone does not notify them.
what is the first text i sent you
Your first message was: “hi how are you”
